pages.text: Farm Rift Shards — the endgame currency from Oblivion's Rift runs and Tier 4 boss kills — to fund the $(bold)Mythic Gear Chase$(), the post-Tier 4 character improvement loop.$(br2)$(bold)Rift Keystone$(): 5 Rift Shards + boss material. Required to open an Oblivion's Rift portal.

$(bold)Mythic Infusion$()$(br2)Mythic infusion elevates a Legendary item to Mythic tier (Mythic I–V). Each Mythic level:$(br2)$(li)Increases all existing affix values by ~15%$(li)Adds one additional socket$(li)Unlocks a visual effect on the item$(br2)Mythic V is the ceiling. Getting there requires deep Rift farming and is intentionally designed as the long-term endgame loop.$(br2)$(bold)Next: craft a Rift Keystone and run your first Rift.$()
